retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist composition featuring gold-toned outlines of figures against a solid black void with centered vintage script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast layout where the bottom third contains the thin, glowing gold outlines of human silhouettes, while the top third features centered, ornate gold-textured typography, all set against a deep matte black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy with text at the top and figures at the base
Color harmony between gold-textured text and gold-line illustrations
Extreme contrast between the solid black negative space and the thin gold elements
Symmetrical balance of the central text block
coreInvariants: Solid black background with zero texture or gradient
Thin, hand-drawn gold or yellow outlines for the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Figures are positioned at the bottom edge, occupying roughly 30% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ornate display text at the top center serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the decorative title, moves down through the subtitle, and rests on the outlined figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the center creates a sense of depth and focus.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle purple and pink highlights within the gold outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, relying on the metallic gold effect.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses heavy, swash-heavy script with internal texture
Subtitle uses a slanted, casual brush-style cursive
Consistent gold-leaf or metallic texture applied to all glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 's' with a distinct terminal flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate decorative script paired with a simpler, more legible cursive subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate, flourished nature of the primary title.
Approximates the casual, slanted look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid matte black background with thin, hand-drawn gold outlines of a group of people at the bottom edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ornate gold-textured script lettering centered in the top third of the frame.

verificationChecks: Are the figures represented only by thin gold outlines?
Is the text centered and gold-textured?
Is there significant negative space in the middle?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold metallic texture
mustRedesign: Any photographic elements into line art
Standard fonts into textured, custom-looking lettering

mustAchieve: High contrast between black and gold

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no solid fills on the figures, only outlines
Verify the gold texture is consistent across text and lines
Check that the vertical hierarchy is maintained
Confirm the background is free of noise or artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black canvas + bottom-aligned gold line art + top-centered ornate gold script = Retro Gold Outline Style
